gravelClasses.note: `gravel` holds every pale ground the sources map, in this order: roads (OSM car roads, at their tagged width, else lanes x 3.3 m, else a width by class), raceways (OSM raceway ways other than the circuit: alternate layouts, the rest of an oval, kart/drag strips, pit roads; 10 m unless tagged), parking (OSM car parks, paved or loose by their surface tag or, untagged, built-up/bare in WorldCover; grass lots are left green), paved (OSM paved areas), gravel (OSM sand/shingle/gravel run-off). createVenue paints them all KIT.gravel.

meta.heightsNote: OSM height or building:levels x 3.4 m + 1 m where tagged (real: true); otherwise defaults, not data: 6 m buildings, 8 m grandstands, 4 m bleachers; Overture footprints 6 m
meta.treesNote: trees from OSM woods (one per 9 m), tree rows and single trees, and ESA WorldCover tree cover (one per 10 m cell) where OSM has no wood; positions jittered up to 3-4 m by a fixed hash; none drawn by hand

circuit.startFinishNote: placed where the site's 2D map has it (site outline fitted onto the OSM loop: rms 49.9 m); 48.0 m from the mapped point
